## Teaching points

1. Characteristic first-step pain with medial plantar heel tenderness is usually a clinical diagnosis.
2. Use the site and first-step pattern to distinguish plantar fascial pain from neural, traumatic and inflammatory causes.
3. Improvement takes time; footwear, stretching and load adjustment are more useful than promising an immediate cure.
4. Routine imaging is unnecessary for this characteristic, uncomplicated presentation.
